title: Equipment Handoff Tracking Log
subtitle: Equipment Handoff: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Equipment Handoff Tracking Log covers equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation. The equipment custody coordinator records Equipment Handoff events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Equipment Handoff Tracking Log keeps Equipment Handoff exceptions visible until the equipment custody coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Equipment Handoff Tracking Log at issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point. Document equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation identity before Equipment Handoff begins. Compare equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation findings with stated Equipment Handoff criteria; route unresolved Equipment Handoff issues to asset-control reviewer. For Equipment Handoff Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Equipment Handoff. Ask asset-control reviewer to review Equipment Handoff conditions beyond the equipment custody coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Equipment Handoff, identify responsible parties, issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point, and the linked equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation source.

fields.label: Asset tag, serial, model, and quantity
Accessory, key, credential, software, and configuration identifiers

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Equipment Handoff facts for equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Equipment Handoff tracked controls
items: Custody date, location, and intended use
Return condition, due date, and unresolved defect

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Equipment Handoff chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Equipment Custody Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe or failed equipment cannot be released
blocks.guidance: Pause Equipment Handoff when authority, identity, condition, data protection, accessory accounting, or custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Equipment Handoff proof and route unresolved equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation scope to equipment custody coordinator.
